masterBacklogAdditions.title: Interview saturation ratio
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: For freelance marketplaces, calculate interviewing/proposals ratio separately from raw proposal count. A fresh listing with most visible candidates already interviewing should decay sharply even when proposal count still looks low.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Closed-listing negative cache
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Persist a short-lived fingerprint for listings explicitly marked no longer accepting applications, so mirrors and stale search indexes do not repeatedly consume verification time in subsequent sweeps.

policy.promotion: No timestamp-only freshness. New LIVE promotion requires active full-detail evidence, location eligibility, confidence >= 80 and no known hard eligibility gate.
policy.failClosed: Existing LIVE jobs are not removed merely because a sweep did not rediscover them. No unsafe write to jobs-data, job-sources or MASTER is attempted where full round-trip content cannot be guaranteed.
